items.description: DinnerElite is an NYC restaurant reservation monitoring/watchlist service: it watches Resy and OpenTable for cancellations and newly released tables and alerts members by email (and iOS push) matching their dates, times and party size; it is not a booking platform
No auto-booking: users book the table themselves; the only booking DinnerElite performs is a human concierge on the Expert plan; it holds no platform credentials and guarantees no table

Pricing: all plans start with a free 3-day trial (card required, not charged during trial); Premium $10/month or $100/year with unlimited watched restaurants; Expert $29/month or $290/year adding concierge booking; accounts created before 2026-08-21 keep a grandfathered free plan with 1 watched restaurant

Coverage: 224 tracked restaurants, 223 in New York City and 1 in Chicago (Bavette's); only Resy and OpenTable are monitored for alerts (5 SevenRooms and 1 DoorDash restaurants are in the catalog but not monitored); 91.5% of the catalog books on Resy

Opt-in reservation resale marketplace: buy/sell tables diners can't use, payment held until transfer confirmed with full refund if it falls through; buyer fees 15% without plan, 5% Premium, 0% Expert; sellers keep 80% without plan; New York listings only where the restaurant gave written consent under NY's Restaurant Reservation Anti-Piracy Act

Markdown mirrors: restaurant, article and neighborhood pages (plus homepage index.md and developers.md) have a .md twin at the same path; also served via Accept: text/markdown content negotiation; comparison, plan, tools, /marketplace and /resources pages have no .md twin (they 404) and their text is in llms-full.txt; there is no public API

Data provenance: booking lead times are DinnerElite estimates modeled from price tier and neighborhood, except 28 restaurants where the restaurant's own published release window is quoted with its source surface; rankings are informed orderings, not observed data
llms-full.txt: full corpus with every article, restaurant page, all 18 service comparisons with FAQs, and per-restaurant booking intel
Per-restaurant reservation drop-time pages (224) giving release window, drop time, booking platform, and alert signup for each tracked restaurant, with an index/directory page
Comparison pages of DinnerElite versus 18 other reservation services (TablePass, Dorsia, Resy Notify, OpenTable, Appointment Trader, Mise, Snatchd, etc.) plus a category roundup
Blog guides and articles on NYC reservations: hardest reservations by cuisine/neighborhood, alternatives to specific restaurants, drop-time tables, restaurant-specific booking guides
Hardest restaurant reservations in NYC ranking, based on booking-window estimates, refreshed daily
Developers and AI agents guide: markdown mirrors, content negotiation, sitemaps, embeddable widget, why no public API
Start page to begin the free 3-day trial
